observation_scope: Acquired official current laws/rules/calendar/guidance on October19UTC with later retrieval UTCs literal in acquisition. Not exhaustive of later court orders or unpublished instructions.

calendar.scope: reference guide; calendar itself directs reader to statutes/rules

rules.scope: full269-page rules; individual rule adoption/effective dates also retained on index

law.scope: actual SOS-linked2026 Title1 PDF, including enacted source/effective-date notes; HB26-1113 amended1-7-101 effectiveJune1,2026; not a bill draft

current_association_guidance.scope: Colorado Clerks Association2026 general voter guide; secondary to controlling law/court orders

electronic_guidance.scope: current SOS UOCAVA FAQ Q16; no individual voter record or authenticated account accessed

court.qualification: Preserves district preliminary injunction; concurrence and dissent retained separately. This is not a stay grant, final merits judgment, cure extension or newly invented ordinary mail grace period.

federal_contest_scope.scope: official Senate contested-elections explanation; ArticleI section5 authority is distinct from state canvass/recount and office-specific state contest procedures

poll_hours.conversion_qualification: derived using standard-time America/Denver on November3, not current July MDT source clocks
poll_hours.in_line: eligible voters already present by closing may finish; dropbox queue provision separately retained
poll_hours.extension: district court may order affected locations open up to six additional hours under1-7-101(1)(b); no actual November extension order acquired; event-day order scope must remain separate

ordinary_mail.receipt_deadline: county clerk receipt by19:00 Mountain Time November3
ordinary_mail.postmark: ordinary mailed ballot postmark does not substitute for timely receipt
ordinary_mail.source: calendar page12; retained complete baseline mail FAQ; current clerks guide
ordinary_mail.qualification: No ordinary-mail grace period imported from another state or from UOCAVA.

UOCAVA.timely_cast_statute: received by close of polls OR submitted for mailing/electronic transmission/other authorized delivery by19:00 Mountain election date
UOCAVA.received_statute: valid timely cast ballot received by close of business on eighth day after election
UOCAVA.calendar_presentation: November12,2026 received-by date, citing holiday computation; November11 is Veterans Day
UOCAVA.current_guidance: mailed eligible UOCAVA by close of businessNovember12 if sent by19:00MT November3; current SOSFAQ and clerks guide say electronically returned ballots must be RECEIVED by19:00MT November3
UOCAVA.electronic_conflict: statutory submitted/electronic wording and current FAQ received wording differ; retained explicitly, not collapsed into one invented uniform operational deadline
UOCAVA.manual_gap: No separately authenticated/current county UOCAVA manual or voter-specific ballot instructions obtained; no administrative API or account requested
UOCAVA.signature: Rule16.2.6 requires signature verification and bipartisan duplication of electronic ballots; timely transmission alone is not accepted/countable Senate votes

signature_ID_provisional.notice: within3 days of receipt/confirmed deficiency, no later than2 calendar days after election; late notice corrective delivery rule separately retained in statute
signature_ID_provisional.signature_review: initial judge and independent bipartisan second review; discrepant or missing signature notification/cure separate from successful match
signature_ID_provisional.deadline: Rule7.6.5 explicitly covers missing/discrepant signature AND missing ID, received by23:59MT eighth day; current2026 calendar and clerks guide explicitly presentNovember12
signature_ID_provisional.deadline_qualification: signature deadline is supported by its own law/rule, not inferred from ID cure. Calendar/guide holiday-specific presentation is retained; later orders/instructions may affect an individual case.
signature_ID_provisional.provisional_counting: verify eligibility; regular ballots before provisional; complete within9 days or alternate SOS period, calendarNovember12; no all-provisional acceptance assumption
signature_ID_provisional.adjudication: Rule18 retains damaged/ambiguous ballot duplication, voter intent, overvote/no-marking/blank standards; unavailable result detail is never back-filled with zeros

processing_release.count_start: may begin15 days before election (October19); counties with more than10000 active electors at previous general must begin no later than4 days before; receiving/preparing is distinct
processing_release.embargo: count information not released until after19:00 election day
processing_release.required_upload_schedule: Rule11.9.5: non-manual-entry counties while tabulating upload after close no later than20:00 and again no later than21:00; SOS may waive/modify; unable counties notify team
processing_release.completion: 11.9.6 election-night counting-completed flag and11.9.7 canvass-upload-completed flag are different; neither reporting percentages nor an HTTP200 imply certified completion
processing_release.source_plans: Denver after19:00; Pitkin after19:00/before21:00/end-of-night; Grand by20:00/regular updates. These are announcements, not measured publication cadence.

canvass_recount.canvass: county completes/transmits by22nd dayNovember25; amended abstract required after changed recount
canvass_recount.state_certification: SOS compiles county abstracts, mandatory recounts completed; requested recount contests certify amended abstracts. Retain1-10-103(2)27-day language separately from1-10.5-102(1)24-day order deadline, not a blanket fixed certification date.
canvass_recount.mandatory_recount: highest minus next-highest <=0.005 times highest vote, after original canvass certification; Senate order covers all votes for office, not selected priority counties
canvass_recount.calendar: order by24th dayNovember27; mandatory recount complete31st dayDecember4; interested-party request days10-22November13-25, requested recount complete35th dayDecember8; costs/waivers follow exact statutory scope
canvass_recount.plurality_and_tie: single-winner Senate highest vote total; after recount exact Senate tie resolved by SOS lot with reasonable candidate notice under1-11-101(2), not gubernatorial joint legislative ballot or a runoff
canvass_recount.contest_scope: state code1-11-201 grounds include outcome-changing illegal/rejected votes/error/malconduct; presidential24-day and local/state-office procedures have their own jurisdiction. No generic state local-contest deadline imposed on USSenate. Senate judges its elections/returns/qualifications underArticleI section5; no live contest proceeding or exhaustive later court docket claimed.

remaining_votes.classification: issued, returned, accepted, unprocessed, challenged, cure, provisional, rejected, tabulated, published and certified are distinct stages; available categories may overlap
remaining_votes.qualification: registration minus votes, ballots minus contest totals, reporting percentages and duplicate statewide/county products are not disjoint remaining candidate votes

current_ballot.later_publication: Adams linkedOctober15 certified-write-in PDF independently lists Donald Willoughby, Will Powers, Ryan Apelbaum; no later statewide roster publication clock observed
current_ballot.qualification: final general list, not primary nominees; legal roster9 is not an approved current live choice-key mapping. Denver setup has6 printed names plus generic Write-in and empty WriteIns array, which cannot be substituted for the three named certified write-ins.
